Gaussian_process_calibration.definition: Nonparametric Bayesian regression with a kernel over calibration features, trained on experimental Tg labels and MD Tg/descriptors, yielding predictive mean and standard deviation.

Graph_variational_autoencoder.definition: Encoder maps molecular graphs to latent distribution; decoder generates molecular graph structures; inverse design samples latent space and optimizes toward target properties.
Graph_variational_autoencoder.dependency_status: torch, torch_geometric, rdkit unavailable from initial dependency check
Graph_variational_autoencoder.implemented_fallback: descriptor/fragment recombination latent generator using string/graph-token descriptors; not an exact graph VAE
Graph_variational_autoencoder.deviation: No graph neural encoder/decoder or validity-checked molecular graph decoding can be claimed without missing dependencies.

Experimental_validation.definition: Synthesize selected candidates and measure Tg experimentally.
Experimental_validation.status: not executable in offline workspace; replaced by prioritized experimental validation plan and held-out calibration validation
